kind: bounded deterministic checks of actual MCP geometry

checks.method: Sum of non-overlapping actual closed floor plate rectangle bounds. Stair opening excluded.

Actual world bounds: all upper plates y=150..160; ground walls end at 150; upper walls start at 160. No open vertical band.
Actual first and last tread bounds and scene digest confirm 17 treads. Last tread north edge z=-63 meets the upper north plate south edge z=-63. Final rise is 0.17778 m.
Three named room shells and three simple bed proxies. Gross zones of 18, 20 and 28 m2 are planning allocations, not net usable areas.
Physical openings were built and key door lintels read back. Complete route clearance awaits actual floor plan and cutaway review. No automated path solver ran.
Concept edge guards and posts modeled. Continuous handrails and regulatory clearances remain unresolved. Accessibility is not certified.
600 m2 site minus 180 covered, 14 parking, 11.2 entry path and 2.4 rear step. The unpaved site surface denotes intended planting, not a planting specification.

checks.observed: Internal bedroom partitions stop at 6.2 m while the roof rises above them, up to 7.3 m. No flat ceiling or wall infill closes these bands. Geometry leaves the bedroom air volumes connected above the partitions; acoustic performance is unverified.
